title: Mid-interview "sequence this against my other two pitch ideas" — decline, redirect to to-roadmap, carry on
notes: The specified outcome is #59's, asserted in four parts: the push happened and the reply to it declined (declines), the founder was pointed at to-roadmap (redirectsToRoadmap), no ordering reached either half of the output (forbidSequencingContent, one rule over the artifact and one over the transcript), and the session carried on to an approved pitch (declines' session-continued check, plus outcome/artifact/approvalMarker). Two keys were dropped rather than kept: `cappedAttempts: {}` iterated zero times and `flaggedFields: []` looped over nothing, so both read as assertions and graded nothing. This founder is sharp on every field, so a correct run flags nothing — but that is not what this scenario is for, and #59 asks zero flags of the cooperative scenario alone, so it is said here and asserted there. `assumptionItems: {}` stays: `{}` skips only the item count, and every recorded item is still checked for its four sub-fields. Evidence that these expectations pass a correct run, hand-built because 03a has never been run live, is positive-controls/declines-redirects-and-carries-on.json — `node evals/harness/controls.mjs $E` runs it and it passes 27 of 27. It used to be a committed run directory graded by hand with EVAL_OUT_DIR; the fixture holds the same conversation, minus the generated deterministic.json that was sitting in the tree as if it were evidence.
